Hello

I just saw a preview of an upcoming card (halito negro).
I tried to look for an answer with a similar card without success:

I play :

Eye of Unforgiving Heaven
AuspexValeren Strike: 2R aggravated damage to all vampires, demon allies and demon retainers in combat. If this striking vampire is burned during the resolution of this strike, you gain 2 pool.
Superior AuspexSuperior Valeren As above, but the damage done to this striking vampire is normal, not aggravated.

With

Target Head
Aim. Play when choosing a strike.
The strike does +2 damage. The opposing minion may discard a combat card COMBAT to cancel this card. If any damage from this strike is successfully inflicted on the opposing minion, he or she cannot use any additional strikes or presses this round, and you may set the range for the next round. A minion may play only one aim each strike

Does the strike inflicts 4R aggravated damages to the demon retainers in combat ?

Are the damages done to the retainers this way "strike damages" or "environmental damages" ?

Thank you in advance
